duplicate_audit.evidence: Batch 2 Donchian used isolated symbols, 10/5-55/20 parameters, 15% exposure, current-close fills, no seven-sleeve portfolio or 120/60 rule.

timestamp_semantics: open_time is candle open UTC; signal becomes available at open_time+4h after close; fill only at next consecutive candle open
entry: close(T) > maximum high of previous 120 closed 4h candles, excluding T
exit: close(T) < minimum low of previous 60 closed 4h candles, excluding T
execution: next consecutive 4h candle open; pending signal canceled if next open is unavailable or not exactly 4h later; no stale execution
position: long-only flat/long; no leverage, short, pyramiding, stop, target, scaling, ML, ranking, regime or news gate
terminal: liquidate open positions at final available close with scenario slippage and commission; buy-and-hold uses identical terminal rule
gap_policy: do not synthesize bars; cancel pending order when next bar is not consecutive; hold positions through gaps and mark at last known close on the union grid; no stale entry/exit after gap
split_rounding: ceil original split start to next 4h open: validation 2024-10-21T04:00Z, reused Test 2025-05-27T12:00Z
primary_path: continuous portfolio with carried positions; window returns use mark-to-market boundary values
secondary_walk_forward: separate restarted-from-cash runs with historical warmup; no fit or retuning
baselines: equal-sleeve buy-and-hold from economic_start with next-open-equivalent start fill and terminal liquidation

criteria.PROMISING_ECONOMIC_HYPOTHESIS: positive reused-Test net and supported positive mean daily CI; >=2/3 positive fixed windows; positive total under doubled costs; no one-symbol masking negative aggregate others
criteria.WEAK: some positive evidence without all promising criteria

limitations: 4h close marks are not intrabar/tick risk
